description: This file defines a final class 'SimpleFileWatcher' which acts as a wrapper around 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher', providing start and stop functionality for file system event watching.

classes.name: SimpleFileWatcher
classes.description: A final class that manages a file system watcher, providing start and stop capabilities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer that takes a 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher' instance and assigns it to the private watcher property.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializer that ensures the watcher is stopped when the object is deallocated.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Method to start the file system watcher.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Method to stop the file system watcher.
